issue_title: [Refactor] _ensure_parent_directory 中 exist_ok=False 与前置检查存在冗余逻辑
fix_summary: Fixed TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory by changing exist_ok=False to exist_ok=True

source_files.description: Changed exist_ok=False to exist_ok=True in parent.mkdir() call to handle TOCTOU race condition

test_files.description: Added regression tests for TOCTOU race condition fix

risks.description: exist_ok=True may mask some edge cases
risks.mitigation: The pre-validation loop still ensures no parent is a file, so exist_ok=True is safe
